Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen.

Tasks

Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt.

Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind: Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals.

Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss.

💰 Revenue Ownership

  • Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals.

  • Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte.

  • Du verhandelst Verlängerungen und Erweiterungen und führst sie bis zur Unterschrift.

🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus

  • Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt: Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams.

  • Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft.

  • Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat.

🛟 Customer Support

  • Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen.

  • Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist.

  • Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet.

⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit

  • Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt: Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist.

  • Du verantwortest Integrationen und Datenimporte: Du scopst die Anbindung an Kundensysteme, prüfst, was machbar ist, und bringst Migrationen gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering-Team ins Ziel – damit ein Onboarding Stunden statt Tage dauert.

  • Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl. Was du selbst lösen kannst, löst du selbst.

  • Du testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen, und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess.

🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen

  • Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen, die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern.

Requirements

Muss-Kriterien

  • Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet

  • Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten

Wie du arbeitest

  • AI-native: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine fundierte Meinung dazu, was taugt.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht den einzelnen Kunden, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu lösen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn die nächste Person versteht.

  • Technische Tiefe: Du gehst ins Produkt hinein: Daten prüfen, Flows nachvollziehen, Logs lesen, ein Problem sauber eingrenzen – und wo es geht, mit KI-Tools selbst beheben, sonst so beschreiben, dass es lösbar ist. Du fühlst dich in einer Software wohl, nicht nur in einer Präsentation darüber.

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo.

  • Kommerzieller Instinkt: Du erkennst den Moment, in dem aus einem zufriedenen Kunden ein größerer Kunde wird – und sprichst ihn an, statt zu warten.

Persönlicher Hintergrund

  • DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

  • Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar

  • Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet

  • Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft

  • Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt

  • Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen Projekten

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt

  • Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience bei alago. Es gibt keinen bestehenden Bereich, in den du dich einfügst – du entscheidest, wie er aussieht: welche Prozesse, welche Tools, welche Standards, welche Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt.

Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma

alago wird von sechs, sieben Bereichen getragen. Customer Experience ist einer davon – und du besitzt ihn. Du sitzt bei den Entscheidungen am Tisch, die die Firma prägen, nicht nur bei denen über deine Kunden. Der Weg von hier führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team.

Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt

Die stärksten KI-Unternehmen der Welt suchen gerade händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt gleichzeitig beherrschen — bei Palantir heißt dieses Profil Forward Deployed Engineer, und es ist deshalb so wertvoll, weil es so selten ist. Bei uns wächst du genau in diese Richtung: Du lernst an echten Kunden, wie man Vertrauen aufbaut und schwierige Gespräche führt, und wie man einen Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert begleitet, statt ihn nach dem Onboarding sich selbst zu überlassen. Dazu kommt die technische Seite: Du arbeitest so nah am Produkt, dass du selbst Hand anlegen kannst — je tiefer du da einsteigst, desto größer wird dein Hebel. Du hast ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis, pairst mit unserem Engineering-Team und bekommst echte Code-Reviews – dein technisches Level wächst messbar mit, nicht nebenbei. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen.

Du baust deine eigene Marke – und vervielfachst deinen Marktwert

  1. Du schärfst deine Persönlichkeit und deine Prinzipien kontinuierlich weiter.

  2. Du steigerst deine Glaubwürdigkeit: Du begleitest unser Wachstum von 11 auf 30 Mitarbeitende in zwei Jahren, du knackst den Code, wie man Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell vorhersehbar und wiederholbar macht, und du baust dir dein eigenes Playbook – eines, das du überallhin mitnimmst.

Du beschleunigst deine persönliche & berufliche Entwicklung

  1. Egal ob du hier die Fähigkeiten für die eigene Gründung sammeln oder Richtung Head of Customer Experience wachsen willst: Durch halbjährliche Performance-Reviews kannst du mit konkreten Entwicklungsschritten alle ~9 Monate rechnen.

  2. Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen.

  3. Wöchentliche Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions.

  4. Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst.

Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern – Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain).

Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Bewerbung – Lebenslauf plus ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen und Wirkung erzielt hast

  2. Erstgespräch (45 Minuten)

  3. Deep-Dive mit einem Founder (50 Minuten)

  4. Case Study (halber Tag vor Ort in München) – z. B. ein hängendes Rollout retten, einen Upsell-Case rechnen oder einen Customer Flow im Produkt debuggen

  5. Entscheidung – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 24 Stunden. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer IAM (Ping DS/IDM)
jobs.description:
DevOps Engineer IAM (Ping AM/DS/IDM)

You'll shape our IAM for the future with Ping Identity platforms. With deep technical expertise and a sense of architecture, you'll shape Swisscom's security promise to our customers. You'll also contribute hands-on to engineering.

What impact will you have?

The department is organized according to agile principles in a SAFe value stream. The value stream currently consists of three ARTs, each with experts of different backgrounds and levels of maturity. We cultivate a culture of curiosity with transparent communication and flat hierarchies. You will be a reliable point of contact for technical questions regarding the Ping Identity Platform in the value stream.


Must-haves:

  • Experience with Ping/ForgeRock Identity Management Solutions (DS/IDM)

  • Proficiency with cloud-native technologies (containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, Linux/Unix)

  • Experience with programming on the JVM (Java, Groovy or any other languages)

  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and responsibility

  • Reliable, Self-Motivated and solution-oriented mindset

  • Eager to learn and share experience with team members

    Nice-to-haves:

  • CI/CD automation experience (GitLab or similar)

  • Familiarity with modern monitoring, observability, and security frameworks

  • Understanding of working in an agile environment and delivering incremental value


Want to know more about us?

We are serving the Swiss market as Switzerland’s leading IT & Telecom company. Thus, we are actively driving digitalization and networking, and tapping new paths for our customers and our employees. Our values are spark passion, aim high and stand true.

Since 2019, we have been building up the coolest DevOps Center with a wonderful office at the World Trade Center in the heart of Rotterdam. We are currently recruiting IT passionate professionals who are keen on developing high-quality software, have an agile mindset and appreciate the collaboration with motivated colleagues from all over the world.

What's in it for you?

Work environment

  • Agile way of working, multi-cultural work environment promoting work-life balance

  • Autonomy, flexibility, opportunity and growth

  • Cool office space in the World Trade Center Rotterdam!

  • Are you coming to the office by bike or car? You can park right here at the office

  • Be a part of our events to build a stronger Swisscom community - for example, culture lunches, fun quizzes, game nights and a lot more!

Allowances

  • Full relocation support (Housing, settling in, etc.) for you and your family

  • 200 euros per month Telephone/internet allowance

  • 275 euros per month contribution to health insurance

  • 5 Paid training days and access to Swisscom learning platforms

  • Travel allowance reimbursement

  • 500 euros home office allowance

  • Gym subscription, Tax advice, and language course

  • Salary range: 60,000 to 65,000 euros gross per year including holiday allowance

Leaves policy

  • Work from abroad possibility for one month per year

  • Care, bereavement, maternity and paternity leaves

  • 25 days paid vacation days plus Dutch national holidays

Contract terms

  • To begin with you will receive a fixed term contract (one year), after 6 months of your employment with us, after a feedback meeting with the team, there is a possibility of extending the contract 

  • The salary ranges mentioned in our Job Descriptions are base annual gross salaries including the 8% holiday allowance

jobs.title: AI Trainers Network - Arabic
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in United Kingdom.

Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence.
In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems.
Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation.
Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.
Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms.
This is a talent network opportunity rather than an active job opening, meaning you will be contacted when a suitable project becomes available.
Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability.


Accountabilities

As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include:

  • Annotating and labeling text, images, or audio to help train and improve AI models.

  • Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness.

  • Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs).

  • Reviewing AI-generated content to ensure linguistic accuracy, natural Arabic expression, and cultural appropriateness.

  • Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs.

  • Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail.

  • Contributing feedback that helps develop safer, more inclusive, and human-centered AI systems.

  • Managing assigned tasks independently and meeting project deadlines according to agreed requirements and availability.

Die Energiewende gelingt nur dann, wenn sie für jeden zugänglich und zugleich attraktiv ist.

  • Idealerweise abgeschlossene TRGI und/ oder TRWI Schulung

Arbeitsort: Vor Ort beim Kunden in NRW, ca. 1-2 Tage die Woche im Düsseldorfer Büro

Unser Angebot

Als Mitglied bei DeWarmte im deutschen Markt hilfst du von Tag 1 uns als führende Marke zu etablieren. Dabei erhältst du volle Unterstützung aus unserem niederländischen und Düsseldorfer Büro sowie Anleitung von unserem erfahrenen Meister und arbeitest in einem motivierten, familiären Umfeld, in dem du einen echten Beitrag zur Energiewende leistest.

jobs.description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

High-Level Overview

Benevity is looking for a passionate and results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to join our growing Sales team. In this role, you'll own the full new logo sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through to close, targeting enterprise organizations across all global product lines. You'll focus on building a strong pipeline, engaging senior stakeholders, and winning new clients who are ready to put corporate purpose at the center of their business strategy.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in enterprise SaaS sales and a track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals. You're comfortable engaging with C-level buyers, navigating long sales cycles, and articulating strategic value at every stage. This role includes travel of 15-20% for client meetings, industry events, and internal meetings. Success in this role requires close collaboration with teams across the business, including Client Success, Product, Finance, Marketing, and Operations, to deliver compelling client experiences and drive results. This role reports to the Regional Director of Sales and is based in North America.

  • Own and be accountable for net new logo revenue across an assigned enterprise territory

  • Build and manage a healthy, accurate pipeline of enterprise prospects from outbound and inbound sources

  • Consistently meet or exceed core metrics including pipeline coverage, stage progression, and closed new logo revenue

  • Lead discovery, solution design, and executive-level presentations tailored to each prospect's goals

  • Proactively identify buying signals and develop strategies to advance and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Track and manage pipeline and forecast on a weekly basis

  • Build and grow relationships with executive stakeholders at target accounts throughout the sales process

  • Contribute to a positive, inclusive work environment rooted in Benevity's values and commitment to DEI


What you'll bring:

  • Minimum 5 years of account sales experience in a remote SaaS environment

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Sales, RevOps, and Client Success

  • Willingness and ability to travel 15-20% for client meetings, industry events, and internal meetings

  • High-energy, team-first mindset and adaptability in a dynamic, evolving environment

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. jobs.title: Solution Consultant - R&D
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.

  • Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

  • Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.

  • Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.

  • Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Ensure that the roadmap is clear to customers as required to influence buying decisions.

  • Provide leadership by creating reusable solutions, content, and trainings for key areas. Work with the extended team to ensure that they are successful and learn from your expertise. Mentor and partner with other SCs to build their success.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.

  • Experience with scientific/informatics software such as LIMS, ELN, or others preferred. Familiarity with antibody engineering software is a plus.

  • Experience in demonstrating scientific software in a pre-sales setting to top 20 biotech and pharma companies is highly desired.

  • Demonstrated capacity to effectively model scientific data, and craft solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices. Prior experience in demonstrating and supporting research instruments, reagents or software desired.

  • Understand research technology generally adopted by biopharma companies.

  • Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes.

  • Ability to establish as a trusted advisor for scientists, and successfully pitch to scientific buyers.

  • Must be fluent in English. Fluency in German or French is a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites 25-30%.

jobs.title: Quality Officer
jobs.description:
Bij Crisp willen we beter eten mogelijk maken voor meer mensen. Dat begint met eten waar je op kunt vertrouwen: veilig, hygiënisch en elke keer net zo goed als we beloven. Daarom zorg jij ervoor dat kwaliteit, hygiëne en voedselveiligheid op de productievloer elke dag kloppen. Je bent onze ogen en oren op de vloer. Het fundament staat als een huis: HACCP, kwaliteit en specificatiebeheer zijn op orde. Jij zorgt dat de praktijk daar dagelijks bij aansluit en je stuurt bij waar het nodig is. Je bent veel op de productievloer te vinden voor controles en om processen te verifiëren. Af en toe zit je in ons eigen lab voor experimenten en testen.

jobs.description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Dat kan alleen als onze logistieke operatie als een geoliede machine draait. Als Continuous Improvement Lead zorg jij voor een structurele manier van continu verbeteren in de breedste zin van het woord, dicht op de dagelijkse operatie. Je bouwt aan simpele, schaalbare en meetbare processen en ontwikkelt een Lean manier van werken die samen met onze teams op de vloer ontstaat en gedragen wordt.

Wat je gaat doen

Je brengt operationele processen in kaart, legt ze vast en zorgt voor duidelijke standaarden en KPI's. De nadruk ligt hierbij in eerste instantie op het Warehouse, met als doel de scope op termijn uit te breiden naar de Last Mile en de rest van de keten, zoals Supply Chain. Je bent direct leidinggevende van het innovatieteam en geeft indirect vakinhoudelijke sturing aan overige betrokkenen bij de innovatieprojecten, zoals team leads.

  • Je zet een bottom-up structuur op waarin Team Leads en teams op de vloer zelf problemen signaleren en oplossen. Je helpt teams om de juiste kennis en vaardigheden op te bouwen, zodat continu verbeteren een vast onderdeel wordt van de dagelijkse routine.

  • Je behoudt overzicht over het operationele verbeterportfolio, helpt prioriteren waar verbetercapaciteit op wordt ingezet en leidt grotere projecten van analyse tot implementatie en borging op de vloer. Flexibel inspringen op acute operationele vraagstukken is voor jou geen probleem.

  • Je maakt business cases en impactberekeningen voor de gehele keten. Samen met Analytics maak je verbeteringen meetbaar en stuur je strak op de gerealiseerde impact.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de Product Manager Ops aan één verbeter- en innovatieagenda. Waar de Product Manager Ops de technical owner is (systemen, tooling en automatisering), ben jij de operational owner. Jij zorgt voor de procesmatige invoering, adoptie en borging op de vloer. Grotere prioriteiten stem je af met de CLO en het Operations Management Team.

Dit ben jij

Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en ruime ervaring met Lean-principes en Continuous Improvement in een logistieke, warehouse- of e-commerce-omgeving.

  • De vloer is jouw vertrekpunt. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig in de operatie, bouwt diepgaande kennis op van de praktijk en combineert vloerkennis, data en technologie moeiteloos om tot effectieve oplossingen te komen.

  • Je beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen Warehouse, Supply Chain, Last Mile, Product/Tech en Analytics. Je weet teams te enthousiasmeren en mee te krijgen in veranderingen.

  • Je doorziet snel de root cause van problemen, stelt strakke standaarden op en weet verbeteringen om te zetten in concrete cijfers en gerealiseerde impact.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, en past je communicatiestijl moeiteloos aan — van een strategisch gesprek met de CLO tot een praktisch overleg op de werkvloer.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

jobs.title: Sales Representative B2B
jobs.description:
Het uitbreiden van onze B2B tak, en daarmee Crisp op kantoor, is een van de belangrijkste focuspunten van Crisp. Als Sales Representative B2B bekleedt je een nieuwe rol in het team: er is nog geen vast sales proces, dus je krijgt de vrijheid om dit proces samen met het team neer te zetten.

  • Na deze eerste kennismaking ben je verantwoordelijk voor de onboarding: je zorgt dat de klant goed van start gaat, actief gaat bestellen, en behoudt de klant in deze beginperiode.

  • Na de onboardingfase draag je de klant netjes over aan een collega die verantwoordelijk is voor service en verdere ondersteuning.

  • Je zet gerichte groeiprojecten op om bestaande klanten vaker of meer te laten bestellen, bijvoorbeeld cross-sell van nieuwe productcategorieën of het activeren van klanten die inactief zijn geworden. Je instrueert het bredere team hierin, zodat iedereen hieraan kan bijdragen.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de Lead B2B om inzichten vanuit de klant te vertalen naar een (marketing)strategie.

  • Je hebt 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring in sales en account management, bijvoorbeeld in een commerciële, klantgerichte rol.

  • Je bent zelfstandig: je bouwt een pipeline op, haalt klanten binnen en begeleidt de onboarding, zonder dat je hier veel begeleiding bij nodig hebt.

  • Je hebt overtuigingskracht: je enthousiasmeert nieuwe klanten op basis van ons verhaal en onze service.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht: je hebt de drive om sales targets te halen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan omzetgroei, bij nieuwe en bestaande klanten.

  • Je hebt commercieel inzicht: je herkent kansen bij bestaande klanten om ze vaker of meer te laten bestellen, en zet hier concrete acties op.

  • Je bent klantgericht: de wensen van de klant staan centraal, ook in de onboardingperiode.

  • Je communiceert duidelijk, zowel met klanten tijdens de onboarding als met collega's bij de overdracht naar service en ondersteuning.

jobs.title: Casemanager Verzuim
jobs.description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Dat kan alleen als al onze collega's gezond en met plezier aan het werk zijn. Als Casemanager Verzuim zorg jij ervoor dat we grip houden op verzuim. Je begeleidt leidinggevenden en medewerkers bij verzuimvraagstukken, bewaakt de voortgang van dossiers en zorgt ervoor dat we volledig voldoen aan de Wet verbetering poortwachter.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je bent eigenaar van het verzuimbeleid binnen Crisp. Je ontwikkelt, implementeert en verbetert een helder en effectief verzuim- en re-integratiebeleid voor zowel kantoor als Operations. Daarnaast initieer je preventie- en vitaliteitsprojecten om het verzuim organisatiebreed terug te dringen.

  • Je voert de regie over re-integratietrajecten binnen Spoor 1 en Spoor 2 en bewaakt alle wettelijke deadlines vanuit de Wet verbetering poortwachter, waaronder de Probleemanalyse, het Plan van Aanpak, de Eerstejaarsevaluatie en de WIA-aanvraag. Zo beperk je juridische en financiële risico's, zoals een loonsanctie van het UWV.

  • Je coacht en adviseert leidinggevenden bij verzuim-, frequent-verzuim- en drempelgesprekken en organiseert periodieke voortgangs- en sparringsessies. Binnen Crisp ben jij hét aanspreekpunt en de inhoudelijke expert op het gebied van verzuim, re-integratie en arbeidsongeschiktheid.

  • Je onderhoudt nauw contact met de bedrijfsarts en arbodienst, plant de consulten en stemt waar nodig af over complexe casussen. Daarnaast bewaak je de kwaliteit van de samenwerking met externe partijen, zoals de arbodienst, arbeidsdeskundigen en het UWV.

  • Je voert laagdrempelige voortgangs- en re-integratiegesprekken met zieke en herstellende collega's. Je denkt mee over praktische oplossingen die werkhervatting ondersteunen en adviseert managers over passende aanpassingen in bijvoorbeeld werkzaamheden, uren of de werkplek.

  • Je analyseert verzuimdata, zoals meldfrequentie, gemiddelde verzuimduur en trends, en vertaalt deze naar concrete actieplannen en heldere sturingsinformatie voor HR en het management. Op basis daarvan zet je preventieve initiatieven op, zoals trainingen, PMO's/PAGO's en vitaliteitsprogramma's.

  • Je benut relevante financiële regelingen, zoals de no-riskpolis, LKV en Ziektewet-uitkeringen, om verzuimkosten waar mogelijk te beperken. Je controleert facturen van externe partijen.

  • Je zorgt voor een waterdichte dossieropbouw en voor registratie en communicatie rondom verzuim die voldoen aan de geldende privacywetgeving.

  • Je voert acties vanuit de RI&E uit, bewaakt de voortgang hiervan en draagt zorg voor het opstellen en verder ontwikkelen van het arbobeleid.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur aangevuld met een afgeronde opleiding tot Casemanager Regie op Verzuim (CROV) of Register Casemanager (RCM).

  • Je hebt 4 tot 7 jaar ervaring als interne of externe casemanager, bijvoorbeeld binnen een omgeving met kantoor en/of logistiek/productie

  • Je beschikt over uitstekende en actuele kennis van de Wet verbetering Poortwachter en de Ziektewet.

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, coacht leidinggevenden in het pakken van hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid, en durft door te vragen bij weerstand. Je krijgt alle partijen (leidinggevenden, medewerkers, arbodienst) in beweging richting het gewenste resultaat.

  • Je begrijpt de organisatie en stemt je communicatiestijl moeiteloos af, of je nu strategisch schakelt met het management of praktisch en laagdrempelig op de werkvloer.

  • Je hebt een warm hart voor de medewerker, maar verliest het organisatiebelang, de re-integratiedoelen en de wettelijke kaders nooit uit het oog. Je stuurt strak op afspraken en de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de medewerker.

  • Je doorziet patronen in verzuimdata en vertaalt deze naar concrete plannen; in vastgelopen dossiers denk je creatief mee om situaties snel vlot te trekken.

  • Je behoudt altijd overzicht in de verzuimadministratie, bent strak op wettelijke deadlines en weet precies wat er speelt bij elke langdurig zieke medewerker.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands, Engels is een pre.

Zit het in je aard om te ontrafelen hoe een proces nóg efficiënter kan? Als Product Manager Operations ben je de drijvende kracht achter de uitvoering van procesverbeteringen in onze operatie. Je duikt diep in de data, spoort knelpunten op en ondersteunt de Product Manager Operations bij het vertalen en opleveren van concrete oplossingen samen met ons development team.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het identificeren, prioriteren en realiseren van aanpassingen aan onze operations tooling. Dit doe je om de groei van Crisp op een slimme en efficiënte manier te faciliteren.

  • Je gebruikt data uit de operatie om de impact van deze procesverbeteringen in te schatten.

Als ideale kandidaat heb je enige ervaring opgedaan binnen het Product Management vakgebied. Je kunt goed taken prioriteren, en een inhoudelijk sterke sparringpartner voor zowel developers als managers van de verschillende teams. Daarnaast ben je gedreven om snel te leren en ontwikkelen. jobs.title: Warehouse Employee
jobs.description:
At Crisp, we are on a mission: making better-tasting food accessible to everyone, using the power of the shortest farm-to-table supply chain in a way you can be proud of. As a Warehouse Employee, you ensure that the ultra-fresh products from our suppliers are processed in the warehouse, and then pack them up so they can head out to the customer!

What you will be doing

As a Warehouse Employee, you work alongside your colleagues to ensure our customers' products are packed to perfection. You will be active throughout the day, with a varied set of tasks:

  • Scanning and collecting products in the warehouse, ensuring all groceries are neatly packed and chilled before they go out to our customers.

  • Restocking products, accurately sorting orders, and efficiently preparing shipments.

  • Part of our grocery selection is kept cold; you don't mind working regularly in a chilled environment of 3–6°C or in the freezer at -26°C.

About you

  • You are available at least 32 hours per week

  • You work with great attention to detail.

  • You are reliable.

  • You have good communication skills.

  • You enjoy physically active work.

  • You are currently living in (or close to) Amsterdam.

What we offer

  • An hourly wage up to €17.99.

  • A solid pension plan for the future via BPFL.

  • A fixed percentage of your salary to spend freely via Alleo (e.g., Zalando, Swapfiets, gift cards, courses).

  • A referral bonus when you bring in new "Crispies."

  • And... a substantial discount on your own Crisp groceries, because you deserve to eat well at home too.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

You will play a key role in delivering ML initiatives across the company, helping turn promising ideas into reliable production systems. You'll work on everything from model development and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, while contributing to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices

Your responsibilities

 

ML Systems & Delivery

  • Deliver end-to-end ML use cases (recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation models, etc.).

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models where appropriate.

  • Balance speed of delivery with robustness and reliability.

ML Lifecycle & Reliability

  • Drive improvements across the ML lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring, iteration).

  • Establish KPIs and monitoring standards to track model performance over time.

  • Ensure continuous alignment with product and safety objectives.

  • Help improve the reliability and observability of production ML systems.

Platform & Standardization

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform through tools, workflows, and reusable components.

  • Help establish and promote scalable ML engineering practices across teams.

  • Contribute to improving self-service ML capabilities where relevant.

Legacy & Advanced Use Cases

  • Take ownership of legacy models and realign them with current business needs.

  • Improve, retrain, and integrate them into modern pipelines.

  • Contribute to best practices around LLM usage in moderation, recommendation, and other product domains.

  • Explore and implement advanced ML approaches where relevant.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering, MLOps, Backend Platform, and Product teams.

  • Act as a bridge between ML, platform, and business stakeholders.

  • Provide technical leadership on ML initiatives and help improve engineering practices across teams.

  • Share knowledge and help raise the overall ML maturity of the organization.

 

Our technical environment / ML scope

  • ML frameworks: PyTorch

  • Languages: Python (data stack)

  • Core topics: Neural networks, LLMs, data sampling

  • Use cases: Recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation

  • Ecosystem: Data Engineering, MLOps pipelines, Backend Platform

 

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in ML / Data, including work on large-scale datasets (datasets of hundreds of gigabytes).

  • You have strong expertise in modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch or JAX).

  • You are highly proficient in Python (data ecosystem).

  • You have strong knowledge of neural networks and practical experience with LLM-based systems.

  • You understand ML systems end-to-end (data → training → deployment → monitoring).

  • You have strong experience in production ML systems, not only research.

  • You demonstrate strong product sense and can align models with business needs.

  • You are pragmatic and impact-driven, balancing experimentation with delivery.

  • You are able to explain complex ML topics clearly (strong pedagogy).

  • You operate well under ambiguity and can structure complex problems.

  • You are able to drive technical decisions and influence stakeholders through expertise and collaboration.

 

In your first 6 months, you will

  • Deliver an end-to-end ML use case to validate impact and execution.

  • Audit and improve lifecycle management of existing ML models.

  • Refactor and retrain at least one legacy safety model.

  • Build reusable ML components that improve development efficiency across teams.

  • Improve monitoring and observability of production ML systems.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices.

  • Help move critical ML systems toward more reliable and measurable long-term operation.

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with a Talent Acquisition Manager

  • Interview with Mikael (Platform Engineering Director)

  • Technical case study

  • Cultural fit assessments

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A highly flexible remote work policy, 2 days at the office per month, with monthly team events.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

jobs.title: Scientific Product Director, Clinical Prediction
jobs.description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. We are looking for a Scientific Product Director to turn this science into sellable products: decide what gets developed and when, define what each capability can claim and output, and shape how results are delivered to partners.

You will report to Gustave Ronteix, CTO and co-founder, and work daily with a tight-knit interdisciplinary team composed of Computational Biology, Data Science, R&D, Platform Strategy & Operations, BD and Pharma Partnerships.

What you'll do

1. Own the product roadmap

  • Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

  • Turn signals from BD, Pharma Partnerships and R&D into capability definitions: specs, target metrics, validation plan, in- vs out-of-scope definition, cost to deliver

  • Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

  • Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell

  • Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

  • Contribute to the final decision of when a capability is ready to sell (based on Data Science’s validation evidence) versus what is not-yet sellable in the pipeline, and communicate it internally

  • Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

3. Design how results reach partners

  • Design the reports, data packages and dashboards partners receive, and direct the engineers who build them

  • Own the deliverable contents: figures, statistical summaries, methods, limitations

  • Embed the approved claims and the QC checklist in every template, so Pharma Partnerships can produce a correct deliverable at scale

  • Keep templates current as the validated envelope changes, and pull or revise one when it no longer applies

What we're looking for

Must have

  • PhD or equivalent in cancer biology, pharmacology, biostatistics or computational biology

  • 8+ years in translational oncology, biomarker or diagnostics development, computational-biology platforms or preclinical CRO services, including 2+ owning a product roadmap

  • Technical depth: you read and understand production code, and can brief and review the work of engineers who build our reports and dashboards

  • You judge evidence: from a validation pack - back-tests, calibration, biomarker cutoffs -, you can state a claim the data supports and refuse the one it doesn't

  • You have experience working at the intersection of scientific and business departments within fast-growing companies

  • You know how pharma decides: you have seen proposals, SOWs and due-diligence questions, and know what a go/no-go decision needs from a prediction

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have

  • You have seen bespoke research work turned into something repeatable and sellable

  • Scientific authorship: Posters, talks, papers or white papers; a presence at AACR, ASCO, ESMO or SITC

  • Regulatory: exposure to regulated or quality-managed environments

  • Therapeutic or preclinical knowledge: ADC, immuno-oncology or targeted therapy; organoid or in-vitro pharmacology

  • Clinical-trial design or Trial statistics: adaptive designs, sample size, endpoints

  • Templated reporting: report-generation frameworks or web front-end

What we offer

  • Mission: work on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Ownership: a product function to build from the ground up.

  • Impact: pharma teams make real portfolio decisions with what you define.

  • Team: an exceptional crew of clinicians, biologists, engineers and data scientists, most with a PhD.

👉 More about Orakl here and here

Interview process

  1. Intro call (30 min) with Gustave Ronteix, CTO

  2. Case interview (1h)

  3. Case study (take-home)

  4. Conversations with BD, Pharma Partnerships, the Engineering / Data Science leads and Platform Strategy & Operations.

  5. References: 2-3, including a direct manager

jobs.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.


Tech Profile

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

Must Have

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
    tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Location: London; full in-office working as default

Start date: ASAP

___________________________________________________________________________

Help build the UK's sovereign AI future. Turn cutting-edge technology into commercial impact.

At Cosine, we're on a mission to build the UK's first sovereign Large Language Model, alongside some of the most advanced AI technology being developed today.

Our portfolio spans autonomous coding agents, specialised AI models, AI-native red teaming and sovereign AI solutions. We're building technology that fundamentally changes how organisations develop software, modernise infrastructure, strengthen security and deploy AI where control over data and infrastructure is critical.

The opportunity is significant. The interest is already there. Now we need someone who can turn it into business.

We're looking for an exceptional Partnerships Manager to build and scale Cosine's partner ecosystem, with an immediate focus on systems integrators (SIs) and consultancies.

This is a commercially driven, hands-on role. You'll own relationships, develop joint propositions, negotiate agreements and build customer pipeline. You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at major partners and closely with our commercial, product and engineering teams.

This isn't about managing an established partner programme. It's about building one that delivers.

We need someone who can hit the ground running, operate independently and turn opportunities into results.

___________________________________________________________________________

What you'll do

Build and activate strategic partnerships

  • Own and develop relationships across the partner ecosystem, prioritising high-value SIs, consultancies and strategic technology partners.

  • Convert existing interest into active, commercially productive partnerships while proactively opening new doors.

  • Build relationships with senior executives, practice leaders and commercial teams, creating alignment and securing commitment.

Turn partnerships into revenue

  • Drive partner opportunities from initial engagement through commercial negotiation, agreement and activation.

  • Build joint account plans, identify customer opportunities and develop a qualified pipeline with clear commercial objectives.

  • Work with partners and internal sales teams to progress opportunities into pilots, deployments and revenue.

  • Take accountability for outcomes. Signed agreements matter, but active partners, customer engagements and revenue matter more.

Create propositions that partners can sell

  • Work with product, engineering and commercial teams to develop compelling joint propositions around sovereign AI, coding agents, software modernisation and cybersecurity.

  • Understand partner capabilities and customer challenges, identifying where Cosine's technology creates real commercial value.

  • Translate complex technology into clear, differentiated propositions that partners can confidently take to market.

Get hands-on and make things happen

  • Run product demonstrations, partner workshops and enablement sessions. You'll need to understand our technology, not just talk about it.

  • Equip partner teams to identify opportunities, position Cosine effectively and engage customers.

  • Navigate commercial, technical and organisational challenges to keep deals moving.

  • Build the processes, reporting and partner engagement model needed to scale what works, without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

___________________________________________________________________________

What we’re looking for

We want someone who has built partnerships that generate business, not simply managed relationships.

You'll bring:

  • A proven commercial track record. Demonstrable success building partnerships, developing pipeline and delivering revenue within enterprise technology, software or AI.

  • Strong SI and consultancy experience. You understand how these organisations operate, how to navigate their internal structures and what it takes to turn strategic alignment into real customer opportunities.

  • Commercial sharpness. You know how to qualify opportunities, negotiate agreements, develop compelling commercial propositions and focus effort where it delivers the greatest return.

  • Technical credibility. You're comfortable engaging with complex enterprise technology, running product demonstrations and holding meaningful conversations with technical stakeholders. You don't need to be an engineer, but you must be capable of getting under the skin of our products.

  • Executive-level relationship skills. You can engage confidently with senior decision-makers, build credibility quickly and influence stakeholders across large organisations.

  • Relentless execution. You're proactive, resourceful and commercially driven. You take ownership, follow through and don't need someone else to create momentum.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset. You thrive in fast-moving environments, make sound decisions with incomplete information and are equally comfortable shaping strategy and doing the work yourself.

Experience working with government, defence, financial services or other regulated industries would be a strong advantage.

Above all, we're looking for someone with the ambition, judgement and drive to build something exceptional.

___________________________________________________________________________

Work on technology that matters. Our sovereign LLM ambition and broader AI portfolio address some of the biggest challenges facing enterprises and governments today. You'll help build the partnerships that take these capabilities into the real world.

A genuine opportunity to make an impact. We're already seeing significant partner interest. You'll have the opportunity to convert that momentum into commercial results and play a direct role in our growth.

Ownership, not bureaucracy. You'll have meaningful responsibility, direct access to decision-makers and the freedom to shape how we build our partner ecosystem. We're moving quickly, and we value people who make things happen.

Build something from the ground up. This is an opportunity to help define Cosine's partnership strategy and establish relationships that could become fundamental to how we scale.

Come and build with us

We're looking for someone who's ambitious, commercially driven and excited by the opportunity to help bring frontier AI technology to market.

Someone who can think strategically, roll their sleeves up and deliver.

If you've got the track record, the drive and the ambition to help build something significant, we'd like to hear from you.

This role won’t suit everyone. But if you’re looking for a fast-moving environment, close collaboration, and a team that takes both the work and work-life balance seriously, it’s a great place to be.

Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records.

With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture.

  • Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

🔧 Day-to-Day

  • Run structured account review meetings with SMB customers to uncover workflow gaps and position relevant product use cases.

  • Prospect within a ~200-account book by booking discovery conversations and identifying upsell / cross-sell opportunities.

  • Manage renewal cycles end-to-end, including pricing, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Partner closely with CSMs to stay across customer context, risks and timing to align commercial plays with customer readiness.

  • Prioritise accounts and organise your calendar to balance long-term expansion plays with short-term commercial activities.

  • Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, pipeline updates, and forecasting across all open opportunities.

  • Collaborate with, SMB Customer Success Managers, SMB Account Executives and Product teams to provide feedback on customer needs and product adoption.

⚡ Challenges

  • Balancing a relatively high-volume portfolio (200 accounts) in a fact paced SMB velocity environment while maintaining enough depth to spot and advance meaningful expansion opportunities.

  • Navigating stakeholders within construction and engineering clients, where decision cycles can be long, informal, or influenced by non-technical factors.

  • Driving commercial outcomes in accounts where budget constraints, legacy tools, or competing priorities can slow momentum or stall deals.

✅ Who This Role is For

  • Someone who thrives in a fast paced environment and loves uncovering, shaping, and delivering customer value.

  • A proactive operator who’s comfortable running multiple deal cycles at once across 200 accounts and knows how to create momentum with busy operational stakeholders.

  • Someone who collaborates well with CSMs and cross-functional teams, but ultimately enjoys owning a revenue number and being accountable for results.

  • Someone who prefers a steady, account-management-style role focused on long-term relationship building rather than fast-moving new business sales.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
Own Kairos’s hiring and build a recruiting process that can keep up with our rapid growth.

We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

 

About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

  • SPAR: The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others.

  • Generator Residency: In partnership with Constellation, a platform for generalist talent to pitch, build, and ship projects that build capacity and infrastructure across the AI safety ecosystem, with advisors from OpenAI, AI Futures Project, METR, and more.

  • Global Challenges Project: A workshop series introducing promising students to careers in AI safety and biosecurity, run several times a year across Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley.

  • Pathfinder Fellowship: Helping grow the global network of AI safety university groups from a few dozen to nearly 100, with $9.5M in funding over the next two years to support their work.

We see ourselves as a portfolio of highly impactful projects in a fast-evolving field. Over the next six months, we expect to double in size and launch several new initiatives addressing critical gaps in the ecosystem.

 

The Role

Who we hire over the next year, and how quickly we hire them, will shape which programs Kairos can run and how ambitious they can be. Until now, our hiring has been run by our co-directors and a few staff alongside their other work, so we’re looking for a recruiter to take it on full time. You’d run our hiring rounds, find strong candidates, and build the processes that let us hire well as we grow.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Run Kairos’s hiring rounds end to end. You’ll manage every stage of the pipeline, including application review, work tests, interviews, reference checks, work trials, and offers.

  • Source candidates. Many of our best hires have come to us through people we know, so you’ll draw on our programs, our network, and the broader ecosystem to find strong candidates.

  • Build and improve our hiring infrastructure. You’ll design and refine applications, work tests, interview questions, and candidate tracking. You’ll also think a lot about how AI is changing the way people apply and how we can use it to run hiring better.

  • Help build the team. Beyond running hiring processes, you’ll help scope new roles and weigh in on org design questions, like who we need next and how roles should fit together.

  • Support hiring for Kairos Labs. Kairos Labs, our upcoming incubator for new AI safety organizations, plans to launch in early 2027, and you may help the organizations it supports find their first hires.

 

Who You Are

  • Experience with recruiting. Ideally you’ve run hiring processes before, whether as a recruiter or in a role where hiring was a big part of your work.

  • Strong judgment about people. You’ll make many calls about who should move forward, and you should be comfortable making them well under uncertainty.

  • Good with people. Candidates should enjoy talking with you and come away excited about Kairos.

  • Organized and reliable. We often have 5–10 hiring rounds running at once, so you’ll need to keep track of candidates, interviews, work tests, and work trials across all of them without dropping balls.

  • Mission-aligned with context on AI safety. You care deeply about making advanced AI go well, and you have enough context on the ecosystem to recognize promising people and understand what our roles need.

 

Why Work With Us

  • You’ll be working toward reducing risks from advanced AI, potentially the most important challenge of our time. The people you help us hire over the next year will determine how ambitious Kairos can be, including our capacity to launch new, impactful projects and grow the programs we already run.

  • You’d be Kairos’s first dedicated recruiter, with a lot of room to shape how we hire.

  • We’re building a world-class team, so you’ll be in good company. Work alongside people who’ve come to Kairos from METR, Coefficient Giving, Rethink Priorities, the UK AI Security Institute, and CEA who share your commitment to impact.

  • Collaborate regularly with leading AI safety researchers, policy professionals, funders, and organizers.

 

What We Offer

  • Salary: $105,000–$145,000 (baseline), $130,000–$180,000 (supported hubs, like London, DC, Boston, and NYC), or $145,000–$200,000 (San Francisco Bay Area), depending on experience, with potential for additional compensation for exceptional candidates

  • Location: This is a remote role. We provide access to office space in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, with optional coworking elsewhere. If you work from an AI safety office in one of these cities, we cover food, lunches, and office expenses. If you work from home, we cover home office expenses.

  • Benefits: Flexible working hours, highly competitive health insurance, dental and vision coverage, generous vacation policy, and professional development budget

  • Team retreats: We host all-team retreats three times a year to connect in person, collaborate, and build team culture.

  • Travel: Work-related travel and expenses covered.

 

Logistics

  • Start date: Flexible, though we generally expect new hires to be able to start within a couple of months of applying

  • Remote, with expected travel 3–6 times a year for conferences and events, predominantly in the US

  • We’d also be happy for you to work out of any of the AI safety hubs in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston.

  • We prefer candidates who can attend meetings in the ET time zone (though our team currently spans GMT-8 to GMT+1).

  • Kairos is happy to sponsor visas to the US (typically H-1Bs or O-1As) and will likely be able to sponsor UK visas in the coming months. We can’t guarantee visa approvals, however.

 

Our Culture

We’re a small, high-trust team motivated by the urgent challenge of making advanced AI go well. We try hard to figure out where we’re wrong, which means we say uncomfortable things to each other and change our minds fairly often. We value collaborative truth-seeking, a scout mindset, agility, and an alliance mindset with the broader ecosystem.

We also believe meaningful work should be enjoyable. We support each other’s well-being, celebrate wins, and maintain a healthy sense of humor even when the work is hard.

 

Application Process

We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

  1. Application form (10–20 mins)

  2. Take-home assignment (2–4 hours, paid)

  3. Interview (45 mins)

  4. Reference checks

  5. Work trial (3 days, paid)

  6. Offer

If you’re excited about this role but unsure whether you meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re interested in multiple roles, apply to the one that best fits your skills and interests, and note in your application the other roles that you’d like to be considered for.

This role’s scope, salary, and responsibilities may evolve, and we’ll keep you in the loop about any changes if you apply.

AI tools help us review applications. If we receive more apps than we can read, some may be declined based on the AI review alone. Learn more →

 

Questions? Reach out at Know someone who might be a good fit? If your referral gets hired and completes two months with us, we’ll pay you a $10,000 referral bonus. Learn more here.
